title: ‘Mentally and Physically Tortured’: Palestinian Former ICE Detainee Speaks Out
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
When **Leqaa Kordia** arrived at a meeting with ICE agents in 2025, she didn't
know that would be the last breath of fresh air she would take for more than a
year. **" I got arrested, and I was thrown into an unmarked van, and they
brought me all the way from New Jersey to Texas."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Kordia, who was freed last month, joins **Mehdi** to highlight just how bad
the conditions were inside the detention center she was kept in - one of many
that have sprung up all over the country since Trump took office. **" I
actually stayed sleeping on the floor for three months straight,"** Kordia
tells Mehdi, adding that she saw women who were seven and eight months
pregnant in her 'dorm'. **" I thought that I knew about these things… but the
reality was absolutely shocking."**

The [Department of Homeland
Security](https://www.dhs.gov/news/2025/03/14/video-columbia-university-
student-whose-visa-was-revoked-supporting-hamas-and) (DHS) says it detained
Kordia for overstaying an expired F-1 student visa, but also cited her role in
Columbia University's 2024 [pro-Palestine
protests](https://zeteo.com/p/columbia-mohsen-mahdawi-west-
bank?utm_source=publication-search), which likely made her a target for ICE.
But despite her detention, Kordia says she wouldn't have done anything
differently. **" I don't regret doing it, and I will still call for the end of
the [genocide](https://zeteo.com/p/israel-latest-genocide-shia-
lebanon?utm_source=publication-search)… I will still call for a
[Palestine](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-palestine-israel-gaza-death-
penalty?utm_source=publication-search) to be free from the river to the
sea."**
